$comment: Komodash Bar Field-catalog overlay (ADR-0004). Maps komorebi-bar.exe --schema field paths to human labels, descriptions, sections, and widget hints. Same shape as field-catalog.json for the Static config (issue #11). Anything not in `fields` falls into the 'Other' section.

font_family.label: Font family
font_family.description: The font the bar uses. Must be installed on the system — run `komorebi-bar --fonts` to see what's available.

font_size.label: Font size (px)
font_size.description: Bar text size. Affects bar height implicitly.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Colour palette + accent. The Base16 palettes ship with the bar.

monitor.label: Monitor placement
monitor.description: Which physical monitor(s) the bar appears on, and where on each monitor it docks. Required for multi-monitor setups — the default targets monitor index 0 only.

position.label: Bar position
position.description: Absolute pixel rectangle for the bar. Usually computed from `monitor` settings; override here for unusual layouts.

left_widgets.label: Left-side widgets
left_widgets.description: Widgets shown on the left of the bar, in order: typically the Komorebi workspace indicator, layout label, and focused-window title.

right_widgets.label: Right-side widgets
right_widgets.description: Widgets shown on the right of the bar, in order: typically system widgets like clock, battery, network.

bar_height.label: Bar height (px)
bar_height.description: Explicit bar height in pixels. Overrides the computed value from `font_size`.
